data.description:
## Description

**What**: Refactor the ci.yml llm-review job to use a narrow integration review scope: only un-provenanced commits (from verify-session-provenance.sh output) and files modified in ≥2 sub-branches in the current session.

**Why**: The current session→main PR review re-reviews all code, including hunks already cleared by per-branch review. This produces ~3 redundant whole-PR re-reviews per 5-story sprint. Scoping the integration review eliminates the redundancy while still covering cross-story interactions and direct-to-session commits.

**Scope**:
- IN: Update ci.yml llm-review job to: (1) call verify-session-provenance.sh and capture un-provenanced SHAs + scope file; (2) compute cross-branch file set from DSO-Story-Merge trailers (enumerate session commits with trailer, group changed files by source PR, emit files in >=2 groups); (3) union un-provenanced scope + cross-branch files as the integration review diff input; (4) compute DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE correctly on session→main PR; (5) suppress TrackerDefenseStore defenses from prior cycle in integration review
- OUT: Per-branch review workflow (S1); provenance verifier script (S5); GitHub Ruleset enforcement (S3); migration script (S7)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, ci.yml llm-review integration review input contains zero hunks for files confined to a single sub-branch with passing per-branch-review; verified by fixture sprint with 3 stories on disjoint files — integration review input contains zero matching paths for those files
  ← Satisfies: "No re-review of per-branch-approved code" (SC2)
- When this story is complete, integration review scope includes cumulative diff for files modified in >=2 sub-branches; verified by fixture with Story A and Story B both modifying lib/helper.py — integration review input contains the cumulative diff for lib/helper.py
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-story integration coverage" (SC3)
- When this story is complete, DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE>=2 is computed correctly on the session→main PR and prior TrackerDefenseStore defenses are suppressed in the integration review
  ← Satisfies: SC6 (8ee4-c51c reproducer prerequisite)
- When this story is complete, un-provenanced commits from verify-session-provenance.sh are included in integration review scope
  ← Satisfies: SC1 (provenance failure routing into integration review)
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Cross-branch file-set computation: enumerate session-branch commits with DSO-Story-Merge trailer, group changed files by source PR, emit files appearing in >=2 groups. This computation runs as a ci.yml pre-step before llm-review dispatch. Explicitly documented so that implementation matches the fixture verification behavior.
- [Reliability] Empty integration scope (no un-provenanced commits + no cross-branch files) → job exits 0 cleanly with no LLM review dispatched. This is an expected steady-state for well-separated stories.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an operator, the session->main PR integration LLM review is scoped to cross-branch files and un-provenanced commits only, eliminating re-review of already-cleared code
